description: This file defines the EmpDependent entity class for the OrangeHRM system, representing a dependent of an employee with properties such as name, relationship, and date of birth, along with associated methods and ORM mappings.

classes.name: EmpDependent
classes.description: Entity class representing an employee's dependent in the OrangeHRM system, with properties for dependency details and ORM mapping annotations.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the employee associated with this dependent.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Sets the employee associated with this dependent.

methods.name: getSeqNo
methods.description: Returns the sequence number of the dependent.

methods.name: setSeqNo
methods.description: Sets the sequence number of the dependent.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the dependent.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the dependent.

methods.name: getRelationshipType
methods.description: Returns the relationship type (child/other) of the dependent.

methods.name: setRelationshipType
methods.description: Sets the relationship type of the dependent, restricted to predefined values.

methods.name: getRelationship
methods.description: Returns the relationship description of the dependent.

methods.name: setRelationship
methods.description: Sets the relationship description of the dependent.

methods.name: getDateOfBirth
methods.description: Returns the date of birth of the dependent.

methods.name: setDateOfBirth
methods.description: Sets the date of birth of the dependent.
